description: Determine requirements and likely costs before a medical procedure.
notes: Inlined Kit fallback implements the full contract and is active by design; app runs standalone with zero console errors (Playwright-verified).

notes.note: The pre-op checklist is a solid wedge — day-of cancellations cost providers real money, so pre-registration SaaS has an ROI story. But it's a checklist with a nice UI; the moat is integrations into scheduling systems, which is a slog. Fine small business, not a venture business.
Checklist mark-done flips items green, countdown 3->1; facility select OK, zero errors.

notes.change: Facilities now show quality alongside price (star rating, SSI rate, procedure volume) with a computed BEST VALUE badge; picking a lower-quality option surfaces a 'cheaper per quality star' caution — README next-3 #2.
